note: TBC1D32 and SCLT1 are known ciliary genes associated with overlapping ciliopathies (OFD IX) and oligogenic modifier effects are well-recognized mechanisms in ciliopathy renal involvement.

evidence.text: Phenotypic variability in oral-facial-digital syndromes and related ciliopathies has been suggested to depend on genetic modifiers, with TBC1D32 and SCLT1 both implicated in severe ciliopathy phenotypes.

evidence.text: SCLT1 encodes a ciliary distal appendage protein whose disruption specifically leads to cystic kidney disease and nephronophthisis phenotypes.
